account_deletion_access_body: Use Reset password on the EchoMeet sign-in screen if you cannot sign in. This page never asks for an email address and does not reveal whether an account exists.
account_deletion_data_body: The trusted deletion process targets your private profile, profile photo, notification tokens, notes, survey or quiz participation, meeting votes, and ban references. Shared company content you authored can remain with an anonymous author marker. This page does not define retention, backup, or legal-exception handling.
account_deletion_info_intro: You can request permanent deletion of your EchoMeet account from inside the app. After password confirmation, EchoMeet starts its trusted cleanup. The sign-in is removed only after that cleanup reports success.
account_deletion_info_link_hint: Instructions are available without signing in
account_deletion_owner_body: For an account recorded as a company owner, the app shows a separate warning and requires explicit approval before requesting company cleanup. Other members' sign-ins and private notes are outside that company-cleanup request. This information page does not claim that cleanup is complete.

privacy_policy_summary: EchoMeet collects what it needs to run your account and your company workspace, and nothing for advertising, analytics or resale. This is a summary; the full policy is published on the web.
privacy_policy_operator_body: EchoMeet is operated by Kushtrim Mulliqi as an individual. Write to kushtrim.mulliqi@outlook.com with any question about your data, or to exercise any right below.
privacy_policy_data_body: Your email address, name and date of birth. Your company, role and approval state. An optional profile photo. A notification token per device you allow notifications on, and your notification language. Your notes, your answers and scores in surveys and quizzes, and the meeting times you said you can attend. Your password is never stored by EchoMeet.
privacy_policy_visibility_body: Your notes are private to you alone. Your name and photo are visible to your colleagues. Your survey and quiz answers and your score are visible to the administrators and moderators of your company. Your meeting votes are visible to your colleagues. Nothing is visible to another company, and nothing is public.
privacy_policy_no_tracking_body: No location, no contacts, no advertising identifier, no usage tracking. EchoMeet contains no analytics, crash-reporting or advertising SDK. Your data is never sold or shared for anyone else’s marketing.
privacy_policy_rights_body: You can edit your name, birth date and notification settings here in Settings, export results as PDF, and request permanent deletion yourself. To ask for a copy of your data, correct it, or object to its processing, write to kushtrim.mulliqi@outlook.com. In the European Economic Area and the United Kingdom you may also complain to your national data-protection authority.
